children: ICICI Securities's research report on GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals

GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals (GSK) posted a decent print in Q2FY27. Revenue growth of 20.8% YoY was on the back of last year’s favourable base (operations impacted to supply disruption at a CMO and GST impact). Adjusting for the base benefit, its revenue grew 12–13%. Share of innovative brands has risen to 7% (3% last year) as it continues to witness good traction in Nucala, Trelegy and Shingirx. It has also deployed a dedicated field force for new oncology brands like Jemperli and Zejula which is yielding results and is further gearing up for the launch of Blenrep in Q3FY27 to strengthen the oncology portfolio. Management is confident of delivering double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA margin of ~34% in FY27. Upgrade to BUY with an unchanged TP INR 2,900 (based on 38x FY28E EPS).

We raise FY27E/FY28E EPS by ~1% to factor in better margins. The stock currently trades at attractive valuations of 32.5x FY28E earnings and 22.8x EV/EBITDA. We upgrade to BUY (earlier Add) with an unchanged target price of INR 2,900, based on 38x FY28E earnings (unchanged).
